lines.text: Your agent finishes its tasks in the end, but they always feel slow.
You cannot say why. Was the agent slow, or was something in the way?
Without data, all you have is a gut feeling, and gut feelings fix nothing.
Agent R Q records a timeline for every task, from the moment it starts until it closes.
It records how long the task was working, how long it was blocked, and how long it waited on you.
All of that fits in one bar, which you can read at a glance.
A quarter of the time, the task was blocked, on something small like a missing credential.
That is fixable. Add the credential once, and it never blocks again.
And a third of the time, it was waiting for you. That is fixable too.
Faster replies, or pre approved commands, and the waiting shrinks.
Next time, the same task takes one hour instead of three.
Once you can see the delay, you can remove it.
What blocks your agents most often? Tell us in the comments, or try it at Agent R Q dot com.
